Locke

the Ashen Exorcist

Locke is a new 2026 champion: a hunter who marks targets with nails, dashes onto them and finishes them with an ultimate that can execute. He deals magic damage through his abilities and the bonus damage on his basic attacks, and gets stronger against wounded enemies. He's popular and banned often, but he's also new and still being balanced, so expect his numbers to change from patch to patch.

When to pick Locke

✗ Better as a counter-pick

Better as a later pick. He's strong against immobile mages but struggles against slippery assassins, so you want to see the enemy mid first.

Pick into

  • Immobile mages like Xerath, Orianna and Taliyah that he can dash onto
  • Squishy backlines that his execute damage can finish
  • Teams with little crowd control to stop his all-in

Avoid into

  • Slippery assassins like Katarina and Akali
  • Projectile blockers like Yasuo's Wind Wall
  • Teams with lots of point-and-click crowd control that stop his dash

Great teammates

ViHer ultimate locks a target down so you can mark and finish it.
LeonaReliable stuns give you time to land your full combo.
MalphiteA frontline engager who opens fights for you to clean up.

Your team needs: Pick Locke when your team has crowd control and a frontline, so you can finish targets they lock down.

Strengths

  • Strong finishing power: his passive and ultimate get better as the enemy loses health
  • Ashen Pursuit gives him a teleport and a dash to reach targets
  • Soul Ignition makes him fast and attack quickly for short all-ins, then heals back health he spent and damage he took
  • Snowballs well: a champion takedown resets Ashen Pursuit, and each champion Purgatory seals away permanently raises its execute threshold

Weaknesses

  • Most of his damage depends on landing Ritual Nails, so a missed Q means a much weaker trade
  • New champion: Riot is still tuning him (nerfed in 26.22, retuned in 26.21)
  • Struggles against fast, slippery assassins like Katarina and Akali
  • Has to get close to use his attacks, which is risky against crowd control

Power spikes

  • Level 3: all three basic abilities give you a real all-in with Electrocute
  • Level 6: Purgatory can finish low-health enemies, so every good trade becomes a kill threat
  • First item (Lich Bane): your attacks after spells hit much harder
  • Two items (Shadowflame): enough burst to kill squishy carries in one rotation
  • Three items (Zhonya's Hourglass): lets you dive in, use everything, and survive the response

Top tips

  • Locke is new and still being balanced. Check the patch notes each patch: his Q and W were nerfed in 26.22.
  • Always land Ritual Nails before your autos. The marks are a big part of your damage.
  • Ashen Pursuit's dash can go through a wall if your target is on the other side.
  • Purgatory is a finisher. Throw it when the target is low, not at full health.
  • Don't let Soul Ignition run out while you're taking burst. Recast it early to cash in the heal before you die.
  • He's banned in about 30% of Emerald+ games (op.gg), so have a second champion ready.
